correctness.rationale: The source definitions give \(\rho(q^*u)=\|u\|_2+\|Du\|_2\) and \(T(q^*u,t)=u\). For every sufficiently small prescribed deficit, a positive two-coordinate unit vector is chosen so that \(\|Dv_k\|_2=\varepsilon_k/(1-\varepsilon_k)\), making \(\rho((1-\varepsilon_k)q^*v_k)=1\) and \(\|Tz_k\|_2=1-\varepsilon_k\) exactly. Finitely many larger deficits are handled by the scalar coordinate. Escaping support proves weak convergence of the first component to zero, so the scalar cluster set determines the full weak cluster set. All quantifiers and boundary cases used in the claim are covered symbolically.
